verdict.rationale: Fenwick publishes a 'Seed Financings Overview' covering possible structures for seed financings, and has a stated startup & venture capital practice representing 1,500+ VC-backed companies, backed by a Startup Resource Center of articles and checklists. None of the evidence names SAFEs or convertible notes, so deep experience with those specific instruments is only implied by the generic 'possible structures' wording. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE or convertible-note explainers, downloadable SAFE or note forms, pre-seed-specific content, and independent corroboration of early-stage financing depth.
